mentions.name: Teams Chat Exporter
mentions.description: A privacy-friendly, open source browser extension that exports chats from the Microsoft Teams web client, with ~90,000 users. Ongoing work focuses on making it stable and efficient when exporting huge chats containing several years of data.
mentions.problem: Exporting very large Teams chats (spanning several years of data) stably and while keeping things fast and efficient is difficult.
mentions.source_excerpt: Privacy friendly open source browser extension to export chats from web client of Microsoft Teams. Reached ~90000 users now. Currently working on making it more stable to export huge chats, which contains several years of data, while keeping things efficient and fast.
mentions.author: gediz
